disposition: Not recommended for adoption. Functional/resource controls pass, but both const Engine policies cause a material whole-code regression. Preserve as the exact control for one-concrete-Engine successor.
timing: No timing campaign or speed claim.

constructor.scope: Same physical source/build path, normal release Cargo constructor artifacts; calling-thread Rust counters only. Worker/C/OS/device/RSS excluded. Header fields overlap; phase peaks must not be summed.

whole_code.scope: Whole normal release Cargo rlib ELF object sections and final executable sections, same physical source/build path and matched feature/profile/package identities. Archive sums include unused monomorphizations and are not mapped pages/RSS; aliases are never summed. Linked ELF reports are separate, not additive with archives.

public_controls.scope: Optimized standalone callers linked to actual frozen normal release rlibs. Same fixture source and flags for each old/new pair. These are not full application code/performance or all-thread resource claims.

core_lines.excluded: tests, comments, blanks, documentation examples, labs, application examples, benchmarks, tools, evidence, vendors
core_lines.uncertainty: Unexpanded macro and conditional-import ambiguities stay charged; inspect per-file diagnostics.
core_lines.tokei_version: tokei 15.0.0 compiled with serialization support: json, cbor, yaml

cross_scope: Installed-source GPUI --lib native check with build-std, Apple/Windows; no Linux x11 flags, SDK link/run or CPAL hardware claim.

attribution.scope: Calling-thread diagnostic backtrace attribution, accepted only after every phase/header/counter equals normal release constructor. Diagnostic build invocation differs in Cargo ancestor config and is not used for code-size or timing comparisons. Counter-retained categories are not all-thread heap; cross-thread thread-name address reuse is reviewed separately.
